answer_1.quote: Automatic generation of content with fine regulation of attributes like sentiment and style is extremely beneficial in this context.
answer_1.outputs: Sentences with controlled sentiment and formality attributes

answer_2.quote: We report controlled generation accuracy... and style inversion accuracy... We also report percentages of related content generation for style inversion... We report attribute polarity score AP... and a relatedness score R... For review datasets Yelp and Amazon, AP is obtained from a pre-trained Stanford regressor model... We report R as Jaccard overlap of unigrams between original and generated sentence excluding stop words for these datasets.

answer_4.quote: With human evaluation on generated sentences, for three different metrics -meaning preservation, degree of target attribute transfer and naturalness... we resort to human evaluation via crowdflower platform... ask three annotators to rank these sentences... and provide an absolute score for relatedness (R)...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators ranked sentences and scored relatedness on a scale of 1 to 10; for attribute polarity, they provided average ranks.
